name: Apideck
description: Unified API platform that connects AI agents to 200+ SaaS apps through one API. Accounting, CRM, HRIS, ATS, File Storage, Ecommerce, and Issue Tracking.

skills.name: Accounting API
skills.description: Read and write invoices, bills, payments, journal entries, tax rates, and more across 33 accounting platforms.

skills.name: CRM API
skills.description: Manage contacts, companies, opportunities, leads, and pipelines across 21 CRM platforms.

skills.name: HRIS API
skills.description: Access employees, departments, time off, and payroll data across 60 HR platforms.

skills.name: File Storage API
skills.description: Manage files, folders, shared links, and drives across Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, and SharePoint.

skills.name: ATS API
skills.description: Manage applicants, applications, and jobs across 11 applicant tracking systems.

skills.name: Ecommerce API
skills.description: Access orders, products, customers, and stores across Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, and more.

skills.name: Issue Tracking API
skills.description: Manage tickets, collections, and comments across Jira, Linear, Asana, and more.
